statement: Newton convergence reliability (param 27) requires a smooth, consistent residual, but replacing the natural e^n transition closure with a fixed trip worsens physical model fidelity (param 28). mfoil's transition-station equation IS the natural closure (enforces n(xt)=ncrit via sub-Newton), so freezing turb flags alone leaves an inconsistent equation: Rnorm stalls at ~12.6 (NACA 2412, alpha=2, Re=1e6, trip 5%).
resolution: Separation in TIME (classical TRIZ separation principle) + Principle 11 'beforehand cushioning' / 23 'feedback': during inverse Newton iterations the transition-station equation is REPLACED by the smooth turbulence-onset closure sa2 = ctau_init(U2) at a fixed trip (XFOIL-style), removing the C0 kink from the Jacobian; after shape convergence the natural closure is RESTORED and a direct-mode verification solve confirms the physics (feedback check). Implemented as adapter-level module shims (ADR-0003), vendor untouched.
paper_note: P1 Discussion: dossier FM-4 fixes map onto TRIZ separation-in-time; documented as methodology thread.

statement: The square determined system (M point-samples = n_A_free unknowns) preserves the no-optimization architecture, but point sampling discards between-station information: evenly-spaced stations leave near-null directions (submap cond ~1e7), so Newton converges to any of several exact roots (recovery stalls at 1e-3..6e-2 with T=0). Improving information (more stations) would over-determine the system and reintroduce least-squares/optimization.
resolution: Principle 3 (local quality) + 16 (partial/excessive action): keep the system square but make each equation maximally informative — select the M stations by QR column pivoting on the pre-solve sensitivity matrix M (already computed for initialization; principle 25 self-service: a byproduct serves a second purpose). Submap condition dropped 1e7 -> 9e1; recovery went 1.4e-3 -> 1.1e-11. The full-curve information enters only through the LINEAR pre-solve (initialization + station selection), never through a nonlinear least-squares loop — the architecture claim survives intact.
paper_note: P1: this is a NEW methodological contribution beyond the dossier — sensitivity-optimal station selection as the identifiability guard for determined inverse systems.
